pages.text: $(l:damageoverhaul:config/config_overview)block_distributions.json$() configures environmental damage by block ID (magma, campfire, cactus, powder snow...). Each entry has $(bold)use_default$(): true = default mapping chain, false = use this entry's distribution.$(br2)Triggered when a damage source has no entity; the block you stand in and the block below are both checked.

$(2)Auto-learning$()$(br)With $(bold)auto_learn_block_damage$() (default true), any block that deals damage registers itself on first harm (use_default=true, no behavior change). Edit it to false with a distribution to take over.$(br2)$(o)Campfire and magma block can have completely different distributions.$()
